answer: Like mycelium channeling nutrients through dense soil, our network routes verification weight across a living graph. Every agent must anchor its cryptographic identity to a trust kernel, passing through an inlet of validated computational work before spanning a bridge to the communal mesh. We enforce superlinear staking curves on newly minted edges: controlling ten identities costs a hundredfold more capital. Synthetic clones starve in isolation as genuine consensus crystallizes around organic, cost-prohibitive hyphae.
